tasks.gr9-economic-systems-circular-flow-t1: Topic: Economic systems and circular flow. Cover planned, market and mixed economies, global economy participation, circular flow between households, businesses and government, and factors of production (land, labour, capital, entrepreneurship). Ask Grade 9 learners to classify economic systems, interpret circular flow diagrams, identify factors of production in case studies, explain how prices form, and justify economic decisions based on system type.
tasks.gr9-financial-literacy-recording-t1: Topic: Financial literacy and recording. Cover source documents (invoices, receipts, purchase orders), journal and ledger recording, double-entry bookkeeping, accounts classification, and trial balance. Ask Grade 9 learners to classify transactions, record journal entries, post to ledgers, identify debits and credits, explain trial balance function, and prepare basic financial records from source documents.
